basic_profile.bio: Based in Austin, Texas, I'm a serial entrepreneur with a passion for blockchain technology and sustainable energy solutions. I work as a startup consultant, helping new businesses strategize their launch and scale. I enjoy reading about the latest in venture capital trends and often engage in discussions about cryptocurrency mining. When I'm not online, I'm out enjoying Nashville hot chicken or attending local startup meetups. I'm married, and my typical online hours are in the evening, after 7 PM CST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Business Management and have over a decade of experience in the tech startup scene. I began learning about blockchain and cryptocurrency through online courses and by engaging with communities on Reddit and other forums. I have firsthand experience with SAFE agreements from my own fundraising efforts.
